verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official, extensively documented CLI (`npm install -g @angular/cli`). Its commands cover workspace creation, build and serve, test, e2e, lint, generate (schematics), update, add, deploy, config, cache and autocompletion, which gives an agent or AI-native user a scriptable first-party command surface. Separately, Angular offers AI resources and an llms.txt, but nothing ties these to the CLI itself. missing for 10: CLI-level AI features (e.g. an AI/agent mode or AI-oriented commands), documentation of non-interactive/machine-readable output for agent use, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
